name: Live Card
summary: A full checkout page with a 3D card that fills in, tilts and flips as you type
about: A complete payment page with an order summary, promo code and a card form. The card picture fills in digit by digit, picks a colour for its network, follows your pointer with a glare and flips over for the CVV, while every field checks itself. The Pay button processes, shrinks into a tick and opens a receipt with confetti.
how: The page slides in: the card flies up and the form rows rise one by one
Type the card number: digits drop onto the card and a shine marks the network
Type the name and expiry: a glowing frame moves to that part of the card
Focus the CVV and the card flips; move the pointer over it to tilt it
Fields shake and explain any mistake; try CRAFT10 in the promo box
Press Pay: a progress bar runs, the button shrinks into a tick and a receipt opens with confetti
